# Glue Sticks and Gumdrops

> > A creative lifestyle site featuring easy DIY crafts, seasonal projects, kid-friendly activities, healthy recipes, and home ideas for families and makers.

Glue Sticks and Gumdrops is a comprehensive resource for parents, teachers, and craft enthusiasts seeking accessible DIY projects, seasonal activities, and low-carb recipes. The site emphasizes kid-friendly crafts, holiday-themed tutorials, wellness DIY projects, and keto-friendly cooking.

## Key Topics

- Kids Crafts
- Valentine's Day Crafts
- Holiday Crafts
- DIY Projects
- Seasonal Activities
- Winter Activities
- Low-Carb Recipes
- Keto Recipes
- Bath and Body DIY
- Children's Books
- Easy Crafts
- Preschool Activities
- Shower Melts
- Home Organization
- Family Activities

## Seasonal & Holiday Crafts

- [33 Adorable Snowman Crafts for Kids and Grownups to Make This Winter](https://gluesticksgumdrops.com/snowman-crafts-for-kids): Collection of 33 snowman craft tutorials for kids and adults
- [Snowman Toilet Paper Roll Craft](https://gluesticksgumdrops.com/snowman-toilet-paper-roll-craft): Tutorial for easy preschool snowman craft using toilet paper rolls
- [DIY Grinch Wreath Perfect for the Holiday Season](https://gluesticksgumdrops.com/diy-grinch-wreath): Step-by-step Grinch wreath tutorial with budget-friendly supplies
- [December Bucket List](https://gluesticksgumdrops.com/december-bucket-list): Free printable December bucket list with holiday activities

## Valentine's Day & Love-Themed Crafts

- [Heart Valentine Suncatchers with Melted Beads](https://gluesticksgumdrops.com/heart-valentine-suncatchers): Tutorial for heart-shaped suncatchers using melted beads
- [Cute Ladybug Craft for Valentine's Day](https://gluesticksgumdrops.com/ladybug-craft-valentines-day): Easy ladybug craft tutorial for Valentine's Day classroom activities
- [Cute Koala Craft for Valentine's Day](https://gluesticksgumdrops.com/koala-craft-valentines-day): Quick koala craft with free template for Valentine's Day gifts
- [God's Love Sunday School Valentine Craft](https://gluesticksgumdrops.com/gods-love-sunday-school-valentine-crafts): 15-20 minute Sunday School Valentine craft teaching God's love

## Bath & Body DIY
